description: This file defines macros and functions for generating memory regions and sections from device tree nodes in Zephyr OS, specifically related to 'zephyr,memory-region' compatible nodes.

methods.name: LINKER_DT_NODE_REGION_NAME_TOKEN
methods.description: Generates a token representing the memory region name from a device tree node.

methods.name: LINKER_DT_NODE_REGION_NAME
methods.description: Returns the memory region name as a string from a device tree node.

methods.name: LINKER_DT_REGIONS
methods.description: Generates linker memory regions from device tree nodes with 'zephyr,memory-region' compatibility.

methods.name: LINKER_DT_SECTIONS
methods.description: Generates linker memory sections from device tree nodes with 'zephyr,memory-region' compatibility.
